insights.one_liner: ChannelEngine is a Leiden e-commerce software scale-up connecting brands to 1,300+ marketplaces; an IND sponsor with an English-friendly sales job.

culture.text: A Dutch software company founded in 2013 that helps brands sell on over 1,300 online marketplaces.
About 210 people, headquartered in Leiden with offices in New York, Munich, Paris and Singapore.
Staff often studied at Hogeschool Leiden, The Hague University of Applied Sciences or Leiden University; engineering is the biggest function.

open.text: ChannelEngine.com B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, an entry-level sales role in Leiden, doesn't require Dutch.

growth.text: Signed Temu for international marketplace integration.

worth_knowing.text: Works with brands such as Unilever, Sanofi, Philips and Sonos.
